{{Youmay|the smuggler and operative working for Hantor Loftus|[[Jaxa]], the smuggler who partnered with [[Bettle]]}}
{{Quote|An ISB squad coming for me? Let's get out of here|Jaxa Lian|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Jaxa Lian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who operated out of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was considered one of [[Hantor Loftus]]' most reliable operatives. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Loftus discovered an imminent attempt to arrest her by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces working for [[Project Lasercutter]]. He dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was able to protect her long enough to get her to safety back at his base of operations in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]].
